title: Salvaging in my Space Survival RPG
author: Any-Gap-933
selftext:
I have been working on a futuristic space survival RPG game for the past several months. I have pivoted several times from three.js to godot and have a pretty nice pipeline now. I'm not looking to build some quick low quality game nor do I care if I make money or not. I gave myself the challenge of making a 3D game focusing more on gameplay and less on the graphics and can see myself working on this for a least a few years. 

This is footage of recycling in the salvage bay where you are tasked to break down items with a giant laser and risk blowing yourself up if you cut it wrong. 

Still have some performance things to work through obviously :)
